parsed.notes:
The qualifications section remains required despite its introductory “some of these” wording; only “Also Interesting But Not Required” marks an optional section.
Claude Code is optional as an explicitly supplied company tool. Generic Claude, Chat and Cowork have no fitting taxonomy entries; enterprise deployment alone does not establish the specific Claude Enterprise product.
“Retrieval architectures” is read as RAG expertise in the posting’s explicit RAG context; “made the architecture calls” describes software architecture.
Enterprise tool ecosystem integration is not automatically equated with API integration or tool calling.
Anthropic, Databricks and AWS are named as partner organisations and ecosystems, not as technologies the candidate must use; the literal reading excludes these relationship-based mentions from technical skills.
Skills appearing only in the responsibilities, including multi-agent orchestration, embeddings and observability, are excluded unless separately requested in the qualifications.
